notes: MSZ 24140:2026 valid from 2026-04-01; official MSZT metadata says it replaces MSZ 24140:2015.
Public current-standard interpretation reports the F1 map zone set -12/-11/-10 C. Domain bound does not identify the exact zone of every settlement.
Named -12 C anchors include Nyiregyhaza, Debrecen, Bekescsaba and a small area around Sopron.
Named -11 C anchors include Budapest, Gyor, Tatabanya, Salgotarjan, Eger, Miskolc, Szolnok, Kecskemet, Szeged, Szombathely and Zalaegerszeg.
Named -10 C anchors include Veszprem, Szekesfehervar, Kaposvar, Szekszard and Pecs; a smaller area is reported north of Gyor.
Twenty named city anchors are materialized; no polygon is reconstructed from prose.
Public technical interpretation reports baseline map values for settlements above 30000 population and elevations <=300 m. Outside that scope P86 remains Q absent explicit authority.
Local urban heat island, sensitive function and other project-risk adjustments are not silently converted to population defaults.
Old -15/-13/-11 C practice is not the current MSZ 24140:2026 zone map.
2023 government Meteo standard-year data are retained for annual energy methods and must not be substituted for the current design-temperature map.
P9 empirical 10-year 72h stress is a historical SCN layer, not the standard design-temperature map.
The broad blocker is narrowed: current standard, zone domain and public anchors are materialized; complete exact national spatial assignment remains open.
P86 adds current-standard numeric design-temperature bounds but does not complete national design-load or COP inference.
